methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
WIPO publications are hosted in the WIPO Knowledge Repository at tind.wipo.int, a real digital-repository platform: TIND, an Invenio fork (CERN-derived, MARC 21 backend). It holds 45,000+ open-access publications and documents. The public entry www.wipo.int/publications/en/ is a marketing/landing surface; the repository at tind.wipo.int is the actual catalog and the recommended source.

## Search
Invenio search is available at /search?p={query}, with a browsable collection tree (e.g. /collection/WIPO%20Publications). Invenio historically supports machine-readable output via of=recjson (JSON) or of=xm (MARCXML), which would elevate this to a near-API. This should be preferred if reachable.

## Filters
Invenio exposes collection and facet parameters (collection, subject, language) as URL params. No formal schema is declared here; treated as opaque params.

## Download
Records at /record/{id} carry open-access PDF file attachments (DSpace-bitstream-analogous). Extract the attached file URL from the record and download directly. DOIs https://doi.org/10.34667/tind.{id} also resolve.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Rich bibliographic metadata (title, authors, DOI, subjects, files) is available. If of=recjson is reachable a single call returns JSON; otherwise HTML/MARCXML parsing of /record/{id}.

## Limitations
HONEST: probes of both the collection page and the recjson endpoint returned HTTP 403 (the repository blocks non-browser User-Agents / bot traffic). This is a WAF/UA block, not a JS SPA; the repository is server-rendered and machine-friendly with a realistic browser User-Agent. Whether of=recjson is permitted for anonymous clients must be re-verified at crawl time with proper headers; if blocked, fall back to HTML record parsing. Family is kept url-catalog until the JSON output is confirmed reachable, at which point it can be upgraded to a rest-api (Invenio recjson).
probeNotes: tind.wipo.int/collection/WIPO Publications and /search?...&of=recjson both returned HTTP 403 (WAF/UA block). WebSearch confirmed TIND/Invenio platform, 45k+ open-access publications, record URL /record/{id} (e.g. /record/28609), DOI 10.34667/tind.{id}. recjson likely available but not verified anonymously -> family kept url-catalog with Invenio JSON path noted for upgrade.
